description: This file contains functions and types for parsing and handling TTS (Text-to-Speech) directives within a speech synthesis system, including provider resolution and directive parsing logic.

methods.name: buildProviderOrder
methods.description: Comparator function for ordering speech providers based on autoSelectOrder and id.

methods.name: resolveDirectiveProviders
methods.description: Resolves and sorts speech providers based on options or configuration.

methods.name: resolveDirectiveProviderConfig
methods.description: Retrieves provider-specific configuration based on provider id.
